provenance.name: Meshy text-to-3D, Stage A of the player-owned lineup (modern sedan): preview 01a14f1e-e984-7255-9109-4efc44219108, refine 01a14f21-3914-76c6-89f9-7b95abc0f673, remesh 01a14f22-c605-7513-8f6a-ad5d2d03a6f0 (35 credits)
provenance.licence: Generated for the game's owner with the owner's Meshy account; Meshy's plan terms apply (not re-verified here). Original, unbranded design inspired by a class of car; badges and plates painted out (compacte.paintout.json).
provenance.note: The raw Meshy files stay private (assets-src/meshy_output/, git-excluded). Steps to rebuild: split-fused-body.mjs compacte.split.json, then this manifest.

_note: Meshy's atlas is fragmented into tiny UV islands: decimating the shell wrecks the paint (a black wedge on a door), so the body is not simplified; instead 5 800 triangles nobody sees from outside are culled (compacte.visible.json), the wheels are simplified, normals are smoothed across the seams.
